title: A summary names every input revision, and keeps naming them after an input changes
about: Two memories are consolidated into a summary. The summary's lineage names the specific input revisions. When one input is later corrected, the summary still names the revision it was made from, so a reader can tell the summary is now built on an older input.

drafts.cognee: §3.4 a derivation references the input revisions themselves; consolidation must name all inputs
drafts.ibm: source material: linkage to the information used to create the memory
drafts.contextnest: §3.2 derived_from records lineage separately from reference links; pinned URIs (id@N) name a revision
